crossRefs.note: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
crossRefs.keyword: not being able to leave the city to collect other fuel

translations.web: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”
translations.bsb: “Look,” He replied, “I will let you use cow dung instead of human excrement, and you may bake your bread over that.”
translations.kjv: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread
translations.asv: Then he said unto me, See, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread thereon.
